headline: Microsoft event highlights new agentic AI features and hardware
summary: At its Windows and Surface event, Microsoft highlighted new agentic AI features for Windows alongside new AI-friendly hardware, with both outlets describing an expanded AI presence across the desktop.

claims.statement: At its event, Microsoft highlighted new agentic AI features for Windows and new AI-friendly hardware.

sources.quote: The company is highlighting agentic AI features for Windows.
Microsoft event debuts new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes
Get ready for more AI in your Windows and more AI on the desktop.
